title: Compiled expression effects from width
statement: Let a word size, compiler size parameters, state, stack position, and memory satisfy the framed-state conditions. For an expression $e$ and temporary index $k$, suppose $e.\mathrm{width} \le F$, $e$ is safe under the state and limits, and $k \le F+1$. Executing the compiled expression writes its value into temporary cell $k$ and leaves memory unchanged outside the set consisting of the address scratch cell and temporary cells indexed from $k$ through $2F$.
hypotheses_covered: A framed initial memory and state, including its relation and stack bounds
Expression safety under the limits and state
